synthesisFocus: NAMING: enforce 'HarnessHarness' (ADR-0011) across all artifacts; residual 'MetaHarness' outside historical quotes is a defect. Phase 2 covers all planes. Focus, in priority order: (1) CF-006 CONVERGENCE — WS-H1, WS-H2, WS-D1, WS-D4 must ALL cite and conform to WS-L3's single authority/label scheme; if any dossier/ADR introduced a parallel scheme, amend it to L3's (or, if L3's is genuinely insufficient, amend L3's ADR once and propagate) and record the resolution; none of these four ADRs ratifies until they agree. (2) EFFECT/EXECUTION CHAIN — B2 lifecycle ↔ E5 execution contract ↔ H1 monitor decision ↔ H4 containment ↔ B5 environment handle must compose into one path with no gaps; produce a single 'effect path' description in the synthesis memo. (3) CONTEXT CHAIN — D1 builder ↔ D2 compaction ↔ D3 retrieval ↔ D4 lifecycle ↔ C3 profile layout ↔ C4 cache constraints must compose; reconcile ordering/authority/validity responsibilities. (4) COMPILATION CHAIN — A4 model ↔ C3 profiles ↔ E2 tool compiler ↔ E4 protocol targets; verify the LCD-trap battery pass/fail recorded for C3 and E2. (5) CONTROL — F1 resolves CF-005; F2 envelope consistent with L2 budgets and H7 approvals. (6) VERIFICATION — G1/G2/G3 verdicts carry provenance and feed I2's grounding metrics. (7) C0 ADRs: no provisional load-bearing evidence (audit every C0 ADR: H1, H3, H4, H6, D1, E1, E5, F1, F2, C1, B5). (8) Every subsystem ADR must state its C0 minimal variant vs its extension family. (9) Write research/synthesis/phase-2.md with 'settled for Phase 3' (contracts the lab and surfaces build on: environment handle, event store views, scorecard, bundle, registry needs, protocol edges, ACP verbs available for the ABI). ADR numbering continues from the LEDGER 'Next number'. Registers: continue from the 'next id' lines in each register file.
gateCriteria: Phase 2 exit (doc 3 §6, LEDGER): all 27 workstreams done with ADRs dispositioned; L3/H1/H2/D1/D4 authority scheme ratified together and consistent; effect path (B2/E5/H1/H4/B5) composes without gaps; context chain composes; LCD-trap battery applied to C3/E2 with recorded results; CF-005 resolved; no C0 ADR rests on provisional evidence; all conflicts raised this phase dispositioned in conflicts.md. If any criterion fails, set gate_pass=false with precise blockers.
